# All Brave 1.100 switches, features and environment variables

Everything that can be passed to this Brave build on Windows: command-line switches, `--enable-features` keys with their parameters, Blink, V8, ANGLE, Dawn and WebRTC knobs and environment variables. This combines [brave_flags.md](brave_flags.md) (what Brave adds or changes) and [chromium_flags.md](chromium_flags.md) (what Brave inherits from Chromium).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Build | Brave Nightly `156.1.100.23` (brave-core `v1.100.23`), Windows x64 |
| Chromium | `156.0.8078.48` |
| Generated | 2026-10-29 |

## How to use these

All switches go directly onto the command line, for example `brave.exe --user-data-dir=D:/profiles/test --enable-logging=stderr --v=1`. Several switches take lists of names that are documented in their own sections below:

| Switch | Value syntax | Section |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--enable-features` / `--disable-features` | `Name1,Name2`; parameters as `Name:param1/value1/param2/value2`; field trial association as `Name<Trial.Group` | [Features](#features) |
| `--force-fieldtrials` / `--force-fieldtrial-params` | `Trial1/Group1/Trial2/Group2/` and `Trial.Group:param/value` | [Features](#features), [WebRTC field trials](#webrtc-field-trials) |
| `--enable-blink-features` / `--disable-blink-features` | `Name1,Name2` | [Blink runtime features](#blink-runtime-features) |
| `--js-flags` | `--flag1 --flag2=value` (space- or comma-separated, `-` and `_` are interchangeable) | [V8 flags](#v8-flags) |
| `--enable-angle-features` / `--disable-angle-features` | `name1,name2`, snake_case or camelCase, case-insensitive, trailing `*` wildcard | [ANGLE features](#angle-features) |
| `--enable-dawn-features` / `--disable-dawn-features` | `toggle1,toggle2` | [Dawn toggles](#dawn-toggles) |
| `--<workaround_name>` | presence enables it, `=0` forces it off | [GPU driver bug workarounds](#gpu-driver-bug-workarounds) |

Notes:

- Every V8 flag can also be set through a feature named `V8Flag_<flag>`: `--enable-features=V8Flag_foo,V8Flag_bar:V8FlagParam/value` becomes `--foo --bar=value`, and `--disable-features=V8Flag_foo` becomes `--no-foo`.
- `brave://flags` entries are listed next to the switch or feature they control. Toggling them there persists the equivalent switch/feature in `Local State`.
- Feature defaults are compile-time defaults for this Windows build. Brave’s variations service (Griffin) can still change feature states and parameters at runtime; `--disable-field-trial-config` and `--variations-override-country` influence that, and `brave://version` shows active variations.
- Brave appends or rewrites some Chromium switches itself, which can override what you pass: see [Chromium switches that Brave sets or changes](#chromium-switches-that-brave-sets-or-changes).
- `brave.exe` is a GUI application, so logs only appear on a console with `--enable-logging=stderr` (or in a file with `--enable-logging --log-file=<absolute path>`).
- A name being present in the binary means the code that reads it is compiled in. It does not mean the flag is useful, safe or supported. Many switches are developer or test hooks.

| `--no-first-run` | Skip First Run tasks as well as not showing additional dialogs, prompts or bubbles. Suppressing dialogs, prompts, and bubbles is important as this switch is used by automation (including performance benchmarks) where it's important only a browser window is shown. This may not actually be the first run or the What's New page. Its effect can be partially ignored by adding kForceFirstRun (for FRE), kForceWhatsNew (for What's New) and/or kIgnoreNoFirstRunForSearchEngineChoiceScreen (for the DSE choice screen). ### Chromium switches that Brave sets or changes

Brave modifies its own command line at startup (`BraveMainDelegate`, `ChromeBrowserMainParts`) and the command lines of child processes. Switches it appends after parsing replace values given on the command line.

| Switch | What Brave does | Code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--disable-domain-reliability` | Always appended at startup, so Domain Reliability monitoring (network error reports to Google) is off. | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L121) |
| `--enable-dom-distiller` | Always appended at startup, turning on Chromium’s DOM distiller (reader mode). | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L122) |
| `--enable-distillability-service` | Always appended at startup, turning on the service that detects pages suitable for reader mode. | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L123) |
| `--origin-trial-public-key` | Set to Brave’s origin trial public key unless given, so origin trial tokens are checked against Brave’s key instead of Google’s. | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L125) |
| `--lso-url` | Always set to `https://no-thanks.invalid`, the origin of Google’s OAuth2 (LSO) calls. Brave appends it last, so a value passed on the command line is replaced. | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L131) |
| `--variations-server-url` | Set to Brave’s seed server `https://variations.brave.com/seed` unless given. With `--variations-pr=<number>`, it is `https://griffin.brave.com/pull/<number>/seed` instead. | [brave/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc#L46) |
| `--variations-insecure-server-url` | Set to the same HTTPS seed URL unless given, which rules out the HTTP fallback. | [brave/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc#L55) |
| `--accept-empty-variations-seed-signature` | Appended when `--variations-pr` is given, because pull request seeds are unsigned. | [brave/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc#L37) |
| `--disable-variations-seed-fetch-throttling` | Appended when `--variations-pr` is given. | [brave/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/components/variations/command_line_utils.cc#L42) |
| `--component-updater` | `url-source=https://go-updater.brave.com/extensions` is appended to the given options, so components come from Brave’s update server (`https://go-updater-dev.bravesoftware.com/extensions` with `--use-dev-goupdater-url` or the `UseDevUpdaterUrl` feature). | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L192) |
| `--sync-url` | Removed at startup unless it is a valid HTTP(S) URL with a potentially trustworthy origin (HTTPS or localhost); Brave’s own sync server is used then. brave://flags sets it through `#brave-override-sync-server-url`. | [brave/app/brave_main_delegate.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/app/brave_main_delegate.cc#L210) |
| `--disable-sync` | Appended before profiles load when the `BraveSync` feature is disabled and removed when it is enabled (the default), so `--disable-sync` alone is dropped. Use `--disable-features=BraveSync` instead. | [brave/browser/brave_browser_main_parts.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/browser/brave_browser_main_parts.cc#L188) |
| `--enable-isolated-web-apps-in-renderer` | Removed from renderer command lines unless the browser runs with `--test-type`. | [brave/browser/brave_content_browser_client.cc](https://github.com/brave/brave-core/blob/v1.100.23/browser/brave_content_browser_client.cc#L1190) |

## Features

5210 `base::Feature`s for `--enable-features` / `--disable-features` (228 Brave-specific, 173 upstream features with defaults changed or pinned by Brave). This includes the 1055 features that Blink generates from `runtime_enabled_features.json5`. “Params” lists the field trial parameters each feature reads (`--enable-features=Name:param/value`), with their type and code default.

### Brave overrides of Chromium defaults

| `UseRoundedPointConversion` | enabled | Enables using rounding instead of flooring for coordinate conversions. Using `round()` instead of `floor()` prevents the systematic downward bias that causes layout drift. Assume we have value d in DIP and scale factor p &gt; 1. Let d' = screen\_to\_dip(dip\_to\_screen(d)), then d' == screen\_to\_dip(round(d\*p)) == screen\_to\_dip(d\*p + eps), where `eps` &lt;= 0.5. Then, d' == round( (d\*p+eps) / p) == round(d + eps/p). Since \|eps / p &lt; 0.5\| and d is an integer, round(d + eps/p) == d, therefore d' == d. QED. |  |  | [ui/gfx/switches.cc](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.48:ui/gfx/switches.cc;l=65) |

### Chromium features that Brave removes

Chromium generates these features from Blink’s `runtime_enabled_features.json5`, but Brave sets `base_feature: "none"` on their entries, so they do not exist in Brave.

| Feature | Chromium default | Blink runtime feature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileSystemAccessAPIExperimental` | disabled | `FileSystemAccessAPIExperimental` | In-development features for the File System Access API. |
| `FileSystemAccessLocal` | enabled | `FileSystemAccessLocal` | Non-OPFS File System Access API. |
| `MiddleClickAutoscroll` | disabled | `MiddleClickAutoscroll` | This is enabled by default on Windows only. The only part that's "experimental" is the support on other platforms. |

Status is the Windows status: `stable` is on, `experimental` is turned on by `--enable-experimental-web-platform-features`, `test` only in test shells, `off` nowhere by default. Allows you to supplement natural language instructions for a built-in large language model with image and audio inputs. This API enhancement is primarily intended for natural language processing tasks associated … |

| `AIRewriterAPI` | base::Feature default enabled → **disabled** | Rewriter API: Enables the Rewriter API, allowing you to rewrite a piece of text with a built-in large language model. The API may be subject to changes including the supported options. Please refer to the built-in AI documentation \[1] for details. |
| `AISummarizationAPI` | base::Feature default enabled → **disabled** | Summarizer API: Enables the Summarizer API, allowing you to summarize a piece of text with a built-in large language model. Please refer to the built-in AI documentation \[1] for details. |

| `UserMediaElement` | base::Feature default enabled → **disabled** | UserMediaElement: Enables the &lt;usermedia&gt; element, allowing sites to embed a camera/microphone permission request directly in the page. |

## V8 flags

993 flags for `--js-flags`, taken from the help output of the Brave 156.1.100.23 binary (`brave.exe --single-process --js-flags=--help`), so read-only and debug-only flags are already excluded. Boolean flags are negated with `--no-<flag>`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--experimental` | bool | `false` | Indicates that V8 is running with experimental features enabled. This flag is typically not set explicitly but instead enabled as an implication of other flags which enable experimental features. |
| `--array-destructure-bytecode` | bool | `false` | enable experimental ArrayDestructure bytecode (experimental) |
| `--test-only-unsafe` | bool | `false` | Indicates that V8 is running in an unsupported and unsafe configuration, e.g. used for internal testing. This flag is typically not set explicitly but instead enabled as an implication of other flags |
| `--developer-only-features` | bool | `false` | Indicates that V8 is running with developer-only features enabled. |
| `--disallow-developer-only-features` | bool | `false` | Disallow developer-only-features. |
| `--flag-processing-mode` | string | `""` | Control behavior for flag errors. Possible values: abort-on-error, exit-on-error, ignore-contradictions. |
| `--use-strict` | bool | `false` | enforce strict mode |
| `--trace-temporal` | bool | `false` | trace temporal code (developer-only) |
| `--js-postmessage-share-immutable-arraybuffer` | bool | `true` | share immutable array buffers in postMessage instead of copying |
| `--builtin-subclassing` | bool | `true` | subclassing support in built-in methods |
| `--enable-sharedarraybuffer-per-context` | bool | `true` | enable the SharedArrayBuffer constructor per context |
| `--js-nonextensible-applies-to-private` | bool | `false` | non-extensibility includes private fields |
| `--for-of-optimization` | bool | `false` | Experimental flag for improving ForOf loops on ArrayIterator (experimental) |
| `--enable-queue-microtask` | bool | `false` | ship a native queueMicrotask implementation on the global object (experimental) |
| `--icu-timezone-data` | bool | `true` | get information about timezones from ICU |
| `--icu-datetime-compat-lang` | string | `"*"` | limits ICU date time compat changes to the given language |
| `--intl-date-time-pattern-generator-cache-eviction` | bool | `false` | enable 9-entry cache eviction in DateTimePatternGeneratorCache |
| `--stress-snapshot` | bool | `false` | disables sharing of the read-only heap for testing |
| `--lite-mode` | bool | `false` | enables trade-off of performance for memory savings |
| `--enable-allocation-folding` | bool | `true` | Use allocation folding globally |
| `--disable-write-barriers` | bool | `false` | disable write barriers when GC is non-incremental and heap contains single generation. |
| `--enable-unconditional-write-barriers` | bool | `false` | always use full write barriers |
| `--single-generation` | bool | `false` | allocate all objects from young generation to old generation |
| `--conservative-stack-scanning` | bool | `false` | use conservative stack scanning (experimental) |
| `--direct-handle` | bool | `false` | use direct handles with conservative stack scanning |
| `--scavenger-conservative-object-pinning` | bool | `false` | Objects reachable from the native stack during scavenge will be pinned and won't move. |
| `--stress-scavenger-conservative-object-pinning` | bool | `false` | Treat some precise references as conservative references to stress test object pinning in Scavenger |
| `--stress-scavenger-conservative-object-pinning-random` | bool | `false` | Enables random stressing of object pinning in Scavenger, such that each GC would randomly pick a subset of the precise references to treat conservatively |
| `--scavenger-precise-object-pinning` | bool | `false` | Objects reachable from handles during scavenge will be pinned and won't move. |
| `--scavenger-updates-allocation-limit` | bool | `true` | Scavenger updates allocation limits if allocation rate is low |
| `--precise-object-pinning` | bool | `false` | Objects reachable from handles during GC will be pinned and won't move. |
| `--scavenger-promote-quarantined-pages` | bool | `true` | Quarantined pages in the intermediate generation will be promoted to old space |
| `--scavenger-chaos-mode` | bool | `false` | Scavenger will ignore age when making promotion decisions and instead choose objects to be promoted at random. This only applies to non-large objects. |
| `--scavenger-chaos-mode-threshold` | uint | `50` | Percentage of non-large young objects that will be promoted during Scavenger in chaos mode |
| `--local-off-stack-check` | bool | `false` | check for off-stack allocation of v8::Local |
| `--force-emit-interrupt-budget-checks` | bool | `false` | force emit tier-up logic from all non-turbofan code, even if it is the top enabled tier |
| `--maglev` | bool | `true` | enable the maglev optimizing compiler |
| `--maglev-future` | bool | `false` | enable maglev features that we want to ship in the not-too-far future (experimental) |
| `--optimize-on-next-call-optimizes-to-maglev` | bool | `false` | make OptimizeFunctionOnNextCall optimize to maglev instead of turbofan |
| `--stress-maglev` | bool | `false` | trigger maglev compilation earlier |
| `--maglev-max-small-graph-size` | int | `10` | max inlined maglev graph size that counts as a small function |
| `--maglev-as-top-tier` | bool | `false` | disable Turbofan/Turbolev, make Maglev optimize more aggressively |

| `--vtune-prof-annotate-wasm` | bool | `false` | Used when v8\_enable\_vtunejit is enabled, load wasm source map and provide annotate support (experimental). |
| `--win64-unwinding-info` | bool | `true` | Enable unwinding info for Windows/x64 |
| `--interpreted-frames-native-stack` | bool | `false` | Show interpreted frames on the native stack (useful for external profilers). |
| `--enable-etw-stack-walking` | bool | `false` | Enable etw stack walking for windows |
| `--etw-trace-debug` | bool | `false` | Enable etw debug logging (only on debug builds) |
| `--enable-etw-by-custom-filter-only` | bool | `true` | Enable etw stack walking for windows, but only if explicitly specified in a WPR profile |
| `--print-builtin-size` | bool | `false` | print code size for builtins |
| `--trace-elements-transitions` | bool | `false` | trace elements transitions (developer-only) |
| `--trace-creation-allocation-sites` | bool | `false` | trace the creation of allocation sites (developer-only) |
| `--print-code` | bool | `false` | print generated code (developer-only) |
| `--print-opt-code` | bool | `false` | print optimized code (developer-only) |
| `--print-opt-code-filter` | string | `"*"` | filter for printing optimized code |
| `--print-code-verbose` | bool | `false` | print more information for code (developer-only) |
| `--print-builtin-code` | bool | `false` | print generated code for builtins (developer-only) |
| `--print-builtin-code-filter` | string | `"*"` | filter for printing builtin code |
| `--print-regexp-code` | bool | `false` | print generated regexp code (developer-only) |
| `--print-regexp-bytecode` | bool | `false` | print generated regexp bytecode (developer-only) |
| `--predictable` | bool | `false` | enable predictable mode |
| `--predictable-gc-schedule` | bool | `false` | Predictable garbage collection schedule. Fixes heap growing, idle, and memory reducing behavior. |
| `--single-threaded` | bool | `false` | disable the use of background tasks |
| `--single-threaded-gc` | bool | `false` | disable the use of background gc tasks |
| `--single-threaded-gc-in-background` | bool | `true` | disable the use of background gc tasks when in background |
| `--parallel-pause-for-gc-in-background` | bool | `true` | Use parallel threads in the atomic pause for background GCs |
| `--incremental-marking-for-gc-in-background` | bool | `true` | Use parallel threads in the atomic pause for background GCs |
| `--shared-heap` | bool | `false` | Enables a shared heap between isolates. (experimental) |
| `--empty-shared-heap` | bool | `false` | Enables a shared heap, but not shared allocations |
| `--proto-assign-seq-opt` | bool | `true` | Enable optimizing a sequence of `Class_X.prototype.[key] = ...`by replacing it by a runtime code somewhat equivalent to `Object.assign(Class_X.prototype, [boilerplate_obj])` |
| `--proto-assign-seq-opt-count` | uint | `2` | The minimum number of consecutive property assignments on the prototype object for replacing it with a single byte code |
| `--proto-assign-seq-lazy-func-opt` | bool | `false` | Functions bulk assigned to prototype via SetPrototypeProperties will remain in SharedFunctionInfo (Rather than JSFunction) State until first access (experimental) |
| `--private-field-bytecodes` | bool | `false` | Use specialized bytecodes for Get/Set Private Fields (experimental) |
| `--track-array-buffer-views` | bool | `true` | Track TypedArrays and DataViews attached to array buffers and update them in-place when the buffer detaches |
| `--superspreading` | bool | `false` | Allow arbitrary length spread arguments on supported builtins (experimental) |
| `--fast-proxy-ic` | bool | `false` | Support proxy traps in ICs |
| `--is-standalone-d8-shell` | bool | `false` | Tells V8 it's running as part of the d8. This flag should not be set in other cases. |
| `--disallow-unsafe-flags` | bool | `false` | Prevents the use of flags that are considered unsafe. Setting this flag will make V8 treat the unsafe flags below as flag contradiction and either crash or exit gracefully with a message (depending on the curreny AbortMode) |
| `--run-as-security-poc` | bool | `false` | Run programs as security proof of concept (POC). |
| `--run-as-sandbox-security-poc` | bool | `false` | Run programs as security proof of concept (POC) for the V8 sandbox |
| `--verify-predictable` | bool | `false` | this mode is used for checking that V8 behaves predictably |
| `--dump-allocations-digest-at-alloc` | int | `-1` | dump allocations digest each n-th allocation |

## ANGLE features

426 ANGLE features and workarounds for `--enable-angle-features` / `--disable-angle-features` and the `ANGLE_FEATURE_OVERRIDES_ENABLED`/`_DISABLED` environment variables. Names match case-insensitively with underscores ignored, so `mrt_perf_workaround` and `mrtPerfWorkaround` are equivalent. Which back-end is active depends on `--use-angle` (`d3d11` by default, alternatives include `d3d11on12`, `d3d11-warp`, `vulkan`, `gl` and `swiftshader`).

| Feature | Back-end | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mrt_perf_workaround` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Some drivers have a bug where they ignore null render targets |
| `set_data_faster_than_image_upload` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Set data faster than image upload |
| `depth_stencil_blit_extra_copy` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Bug in some drivers triggers a TDR when using CopySubresourceRegion from a staging texture to a depth/stencil |
| `expand_integer_pow_expressions` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | The HLSL optimizer has a bug with optimizing 'pow' in certain integer-valued expressions |
| `flush_after_ending_transform_feedback` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Some drivers sometimes write out-of-order results to StreamOut buffers when transform feedback is used to repeatedly write to the same buffer positions |
| `get_dimensions_ignores_base_level` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Some drivers do not take into account the base level of the texture in the results of the HLSL GetDimensions builtin |
| `pre_add_texel_fetch_offsets` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | HLSL's function texture.Load returns 0 when the parameter Location is negative, even if the sum of Offset and Location is in range |
| `emulate_tiny_stencil_textures` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | 1x1 and 2x2 mips of depth/stencil textures aren't sampled correctly |
| `rewrite_unary_minus_operator` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Evaluating unary minus operator on integer may get wrong answer in vertex shaders |
| `emulate_isnan_float` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Using isnan() on highp float will get wrong answer |
| `call_clear_twice` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Using clear() may not take effect |
| `use_system_memory_for_constant_buffers` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Copying from staging storage to constant buffer storage does not work |
| `select_view_in_geometry_shader` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | The viewport or render target slice will be selected in the geometry shader stage for the ANGLE\_multiview extension |
| `add_mock_texture_no_render_target` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | On some drivers when rendering with no render target, two bugs lead to incorrect behavior |
| `force_atomic_value_resolution` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | On some drivers the return value from RWByteAddressBuffer.InterlockedAdd does not resolve when used in the .yzw components of a RWByteAddressBuffer.Store operation |
| `allow_clear_for_robust_resource_init` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Some drivers corrupt texture data when clearing for robust resource initialization. |
| `allow_translate_uniform_block_to_structured_buffer` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | There is a slow fxc compile performance issue with dynamic uniform indexing if translating a uniform block with a large array member to cbuffer. |
| `disable_rasterizer_order_views` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Disable ROVs for testing |
| `enable_timestamp_queries` | D3D (default on Windows) | Workarounds | Enable timestamp on GL\_EXT\_disjoint\_timer\_query extension |
| `lose_context_on_out_of_memory` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Some users rely on a lost context notification if a GL\_OUT\_OF\_MEMORY error occurs |
| `lose_hardened_context_on_backend_error` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | On hardened contexts, lose context if the backend generates an error |
| `disallow_non_zero_base_level_and_incompatible_levels_on_hardened_contexts` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | On hardened contexts, disallow redeclaring mutable texture levels incompatibly and changing the base level to something other than zero |
| `disable_program_caching_for_transform_feedback` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | On some GPUs, program binaries don't contain transform feedback varyings |
| `disable_program_binary` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Disable support for GL\_OES\_get\_program\_binary |
| `disable_anisotropic_filtering` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Disable support for anisotropic filtering |
| `allow_compressed_formats` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Allow compressed formats |
| `single_threaded_texture_decompression` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Disables multi-threaded decompression of compressed texture formats |
| `force_depth_attachment_init_on_clear` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Force depth attachment initialization on clear ops |
| `enable_capture_limits` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Set the context limits like frame capturing was enabled |
| `force_robust_resource_init` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force-enable robust resource init |
| `force_init_shader_variables` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force-enable shader variable initialization |
| `enable_program_binary_for_capture` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Even if FrameCapture is enabled, enable GL\_OES\_get\_program\_binary |
| `force_gl_error_checking` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force GL error checking (i.e. prevent applications from disabling error checking |
| `emulate_pixel_local_storage` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Emulate ANGLE\_shader\_pixel\_local\_storage using shader images |
| `use_ir` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Use the translator's IR instead of AST |
| `cache_compiled_shader` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Enable to cache compiled shaders |
| `dump_shader_source` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Write shader source to temp directory |
| `enable_shader_substitution` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Check the filesystem for shaders to use instead of those provided through glShaderSource |
| `disable_program_caching` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Disables saving programs to the cache |
| `dump_translated_shaders` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Write translated shaders to temp directory |
| `enable_translated_shader_substitution` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Check the filesystem for translated shaders to use instead of the shader translator's |
| `compile_job_is_thread_safe` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | If false, parts of the compile job cannot be parallelized |
| `link_job_is_thread_safe` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | If false, parts of the link job cannot be parallelized |
| `always_run_link_sub_jobs_threaded` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | If true, sub tasks of the link job are always threaded, regardless of GL\_KHR\_parallel\_shader\_compile |
| `uncurrent_egl_surface_upon_surface_destroy` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Make egl surface uncurrent when calling eglDestroySurface(), if the surface is still bound by the context of current render thread |
| `force_minimum_max_vertex_attributes` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force the minimum GL\_MAX\_VERTEX\_ATTRIBS that the context's client version allows. |
| `force_flush_after_drawcall_using_shadowmap` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Force flush after drawcall use shadow map for intel device. |
| `always_enable_emulated_multidraw_extensions` | frontend (all back-ends) | Workarounds | Enable multi-draw and base vertex base instance extensions for non-WebGL contexts if they are emulated. |
| `force_passthrough_shaders` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Parse shaders for reflection but do not translate them. |
| `enable_create_context_backwards_compatible` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | It allows the creation of a context with a requested version by exposing EGL\_ANGLE\_create\_context\_backwards\_compatible. |
| `clip_cull_distance_broken_with_passthrough_shaders` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | GL\_EXT\_clip\_cull\_distance requires shader transformations to function at all on some drivers. |
| `noperspective_interpolation_broken_with_passthrough_shaders` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | GL\_NV\_shader\_noperspective\_interpolation requires shader transformations to function at all on some drivers. |
| `force_debug_contexts` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force every context into debug mode as if EGL\_CONTEXT\_OPENGL\_DEBUG\_BIT\_KHR was used. |
| `limit_max_buffer_bytes_to_1MB` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force a max buffer size of 1MB for testing. |
| `limit_max_texture_bytes_to_1MB` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Force a max image size of 1MB for testing. |
| `allow_extension_disable_after_non_pp_tokens` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Allow #extension ... : disable after non preprocessor tokens in WebGL. |
| `set_need_init_on_invalidation` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | Set Texture's InitState to MayNeedInit inside invalidateFramebuffer or discardFramebuffer. |
| `compress_program_binary_blob` | frontend (all back-ends) | Features | If true, compress the blob when glGetProgramiv is used to query the binary length and glGetProgramBinary is used to retrieve it. Also decompress the blob when glProgramBinary is called. |
| `avoid_1_bit_alpha_texture_formats` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Issue with 1-bit alpha framebuffer formats |
| `RGBA4_is_not_supported_for_color_rendering` | OpenGL | Workarounds | GL\_RGBA4 is not color renderable |
| `allow_astc_formats` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Enable ASTC on desktop OpenGL |
| `clears_with_gaps_need_flush` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Clearing an FBO with multiple attachments may need a flush to avoid race conditions |
| `finish_does_not_cause_queries_to_be_available` | OpenGL | Workarounds | glFinish doesn't cause all queries to report available result |
| `always_call_use_program_after_link` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Always call useProgram after a successful link to avoid a driver bug |
| `unpack_overlapping_rows_separately_unpack_buffer` | OpenGL | Workarounds | In the case of unpacking from a pixel unpack buffer, unpack overlapping rows row by row |
| `pack_overlapping_rows_separately_pack_buffer` | OpenGL | Workarounds | In the case of packing to a pixel pack buffer, pack overlapping rows row by row |
| `pack_large_row_length_separately_pack_buffer` | OpenGL | Workarounds | When packing to a pixel pack buffer with a row pitch &gt;= 256MiB, pack row by row. Mali GLES computes stride in bits as int32; row\_length\*bpp\*8 wraps at 0x10000000. |
| `initialize_current_vertex_attributes` | OpenGL | Workarounds | During initialization, assign the current vertex attributes to the spec-mandated defaults |
| `emulate_abs_int_function` | OpenGL | Workarounds | abs(i) where i is an integer returns unexpected result |
| `add_and_true_to_loop_condition` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Calculation of loop conditions in for and while loop has bug |
| `unpack_last_row_separately_for_padding_inclusion` | OpenGL | Workarounds | When uploading textures from an unpack buffer, some drivers count an extra row padding |
| `pack_last_row_separately_for_padding_inclusion` | OpenGL | Workarounds | When uploading textures from an pack buffer, some drivers count an extra row padding |
| `use_unused_blocks_with_standard_or_shared_layout` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Unused std140 or shared uniform blocks will be treated as inactive |
| `emulate_atan_2_float` | OpenGL | Workarounds | atan(y, x) may return a wrong answer |
| `emulate_max_vertex_attrib_stride` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers return 0 when MAX\_VERTEX\_ATTRIB\_STRIED queried |
| `dont_initialize_uninitialized_locals` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Initializing uninitialized locals caused odd behavior in a few WebGL 2 tests |
| `clamp_point_size` | OpenGL | Workarounds | The point size range reported from the API is inconsistent with the actual behavior |
| `force_max_combined_shader_output_resources` | OpenGL | Features | Force GL\_MAX\_COMBINED\_SHADER\_OUTPUT\_RESOURCES to be the sum of GL\_MAX\_COMBINED\_IMAGE\_UNIFORMS, GL\_MAX\_COMBINED\_SHADER\_STORAGE\_BLOCKS, and GL\_MAX\_COLOR\_ATTACHMENTS |
| `dont_use_loops_to_initialize_variables` | OpenGL | Workarounds | For loops used to initialize variables hit native GLSL compiler bugs |
| `clamp_frag_depth` | OpenGL | Workarounds | gl\_FragDepth is not clamped correctly when rendering to a floating point depth buffer |
| `rewrite_repeated_assign_to_swizzled` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Repeated assignment to swizzled values inside a GLSL user-defined function have incorrect results |
| `pre_transform_texture_cube_grad_derivatives` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Apply a vendor-specific transformation to explicit cubemap derivatives |
| `query_counter_bits_generates_errors` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Drivers generate errors when querying the number of bits in timer queries |
| `limit_webgl_max_texture_size_to_4096` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Limit webgl max texture size to 4096 to avoid frequent out-of-memory errors |
| `limit_webgl_max_texture_size_to_8192` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Limit webgl max texture size to 8192 to avoid frequent out-of-memory errors |
| `allow_clear_for_robust_resource_init` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Using glClear for robust resource initialization is buggy on some drivers and leads to texture corruption. Default to data uploads except on MacOS where it is very slow. |
| `clamp_array_access` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Clamp uniform array access to avoid reading invalid memory. |
| `recreate_immutable_texture_on_base_level_increase` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Recreate native storage for immutable textures when TEXTURE\_BASE\_LEVEL is increased to work around PowerVR sparse page map OOB driver bug. |
| `recreate_texture_on_tex_image_3d_depth_increase` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Recreate texture and copy existing levels when glTexImage3D is called on a mutable TEXTURE\_3D texture with an increased depth to work around Qualcomm driver bug. |
| `limit_max_3d_array_texture_size_to_1024` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Limit max 3d texture size and max array texture layers to 1024 to avoid system hang |
| `unfold_short_circuits` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Mac incorrectly executes both sides of && and \|\| expressions when they should short-circuit. |
| `emulate_primitive_restart_fixed_index` | OpenGL | Workarounds | When GL\_PRIMITIVE\_RESTART\_FIXED\_INDEX is not available, emulate it with GL\_PRIMITIVE\_RESTART and glPrimitiveRestartIndex. |
| `set_primitive_restart_fixed_index_for_draw_arrays` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers discard vertex data in DrawArrays calls when the fixed primitive restart index is within the number of primitives being drawn. |
| `remove_dynamic_indexing_of_swizzled_vector` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Dynamic indexing of swizzled l-values doesn't work correctly on various platforms. |
| `pre_add_texel_fetch_offsets` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Intel Mac drivers mistakenly consider the parameter position of nagative vaule as invalid even if the sum of position and offset is in range, so we need to add workarounds by rewriting texelFetchOffset(sampler, position, lod, offset) into texelFetch(sampler, position + offset, lod). |
| `read_pixels_using_implementation_color_read_format_for_norm16` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Quite some OpenGL ES drivers don't implement readPixels for RGBA/UNSIGNED\_SHORT from EXT\_texture\_norm16 correctly |
| `flush_before_delete_texture_if_copied_to` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers track CopyTex{Sub}Image texture dependencies incorrectly. Flush before glDeleteTextures in this case |
| `rewrite_row_major_matrices` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Rewrite row major matrices in shaders as column major as a driver bug workaround |
| `disable_draw_buffers_indexed` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable OES\_draw\_buffers\_indexed extension. |
| `disable_semaphore_fd` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable GL\_EXT\_semaphore\_fd extension |
| `disable_timestamp_queries` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable GL\_EXT\_disjoint\_timer\_query extension |
| `disable_native_parallel_compile` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Do not use native KHR\_parallel\_shader\_compile even when available. |
| `emulate_pack_skip_rows_and_pack_skip_pixels` | OpenGL | Workarounds | GL\_PACK\_SKIP\_ROWS and GL\_PACK\_SKIP\_PIXELS are ignored in Apple's OpenGL driver. |
| `clamp_msc_rate` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers return bogus values for GetMscRate, so we clamp it to 30Hz |
| `bind_transform_feedback_buffer_before_bind_buffer_range` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Bind transform feedback buffers to the generic binding point before calling glBindBufferBase or glBindBufferRange. |
| `disable_sync_control_support` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Speculative fix for issues on Linux/Wayland where exposing GLX\_OML\_sync\_control renders Chrome unusable |
| `keep_buffer_shadow_copy` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Maintain a shadow copy of buffer data when the GL API does not permit reading data back. |
| `promote_packed_formats_to_8_bit_per_channel` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Packed color formats are buggy on Macs with AMD GPUs |
| `init_fragment_output_variables` | OpenGL | Workarounds | No init gl\_FragColor causes context lost |
| `shift_instanced_array_data_with_offset` | OpenGL | Workarounds | glDrawArraysInstanced is buggy on certain new Mac Intel GPUs |
| `sync_all_vertex_arrays_to_default` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Only use the default VAO because of missing support or driver bugs |
| `sync_default_vertex_arrays_to_default` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Sync all frontend vertex array objects to the driver default vertex array |
| `flush_on_framebuffer_change` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Switching framebuffers without a flush can lead to crashes on Intel 9th Generation GPU Macs. |
| `disable_multisampled_render_to_texture` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Many drivers have bugs when using GL\_EXT\_multisampled\_render\_to\_texture |
| `upload_texture_data_in_chunks` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Upload texture data in &lt;120kb chunks to work around Mac driver hangs and crashes. |
| `emulate_immutable_compressed_texture_3D` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Use non-immutable texture allocation to work around a driver bug. |
| `always_unbind_framebuffer_texture_2D` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Force unbind framebufferTexture2D before binding renderbuffer to work around driver bug. |
| `disable_texture_clamp_to_border` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Imagination devices generate INVALID\_ENUM when setting the texture border color. |
| `pass_highp_to_pack_unorm_snorm_builtins` | OpenGL | Workarounds | packUnorm4x8 fails on Pixel 4 if it is not passed a highp vec4. |
| `emulate_clip_distance_state` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers ignore GL\_CLIP\_DISTANCEi\_EXT state. |
| `emulate_clip_origin` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers incorrectly apply GL\_CLIP\_ORIGIN\_EXT state. |
| `bind_complete_framebuffer_for_timer_queries` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers require a complete framebuffer when beginQuery for TimeElapsed or Timestampis called. |
| `disable_base_instance_vertex` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers have buggy implementations of glDraw\*BaseVertex\*. |
| `disable_clip_control` | OpenGL | Features | Some devices genenerate errors when querying the clip control state |
| `scalarize_vec_and_mat_constructor_args` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Rewrite vec/mat constructors to work around driver bugs |
| `ensure_non_empty_buffer_is_bound_for_draw` | OpenGL | Features | Apple OpenGL drivers crash when drawing with a zero-sized buffer bound using a non-zero divisor. |
| `explicit_fragment_locations` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Always write explicit location layout qualifiers for fragment outputs. |
| `disable_render_snorm` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable EXT\_render\_snorm extension. |
| `disable_texture_mirror_clamp_to_edge` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable EXT\_texture\_mirror\_clamp\_to\_edge extension. |
| `resync_depth_range_on_clip_control` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Resync depth range to apply clip control updates. |
| `corrupt_program_binary_for_testing` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Corrupt the program binary retrieved from the driver for testing purposes. |
| `emit_max_glsl_400_for_testing` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Avoid GLSL versions above 4.0 for testing purposes. |
| `use_intermediate_texture_for_generate_mipmap` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers lose context when repeatedly generating mipmaps on textures that were used as framebuffers. |
| `avoid_bind_frag_data_location` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Qualcomm drivers fail to link after binding fragment data locations. |
| `srgb_blending_broken` | OpenGL | Workarounds | SRGB blending does not appear to work correctly on the some Qualcomm devices. Writing to an SRGB framebuffer with GL\_FRAMEBUFFER\_SRGB enabled and then reading back returns the same value. Disabling GL\_FRAMEBUFFER\_SRGB will then convert in the wrong direction. |
| `bgra_tex_image_formats_broken` | OpenGL | Workarounds | BGRA formats do not appear to be accepted by some qualcomm despite the extension being exposed. |
| `disable_tiled_rendering` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable QCOM\_tiled\_rendering on devices with rendering artifacts or which improperly expose the extension. |
| `disable_blend_equation_advanced` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Disable GL\_KHR\_blend\_equation\_advanced due to various driver issues. |
| `disable_passthrough_shaders` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some ES2 Mali drivers are unable to query enough information from a linked program to use passthrough shaders. |
| `disable_clear_tex_image_for_robust_init` | OpenGL | Workarounds | IMG drivers are unable to handle glClearTexImage with various format combinations. |
| `multiview_via_viewport_array` | OpenGL | Features | Use ARB\_shader\_viewport\_layer\_array or NV\_viewport\_array2 to implement multiview |
| `validate_max_per_stage_uniform_blocks_at_compile_time` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Validate GL\_MAX\_\*\_UNIFORM\_BLOCKS at compile time instead of link time to work around compiler bugs. |
| `recreate_mipmap_levels_before_generate` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Before calling glGenerateMipmap on a mutable texture, recreate levels that the driver is supposed to recreate to work around driver bugs. |
| `limit_max_buffer_size_to_1gb` | OpenGL | Workarounds | Some drivers have internal failures when attempting to allocate and initialize buffers larger than 1gb. |

Reduces per-vertex instructions. |
